question: The parent repo's git index is shared across agents; which of pathspec-commit / index-lock / per-agent GIT_INDEX_FILE actually fixes the sweeping, verified by planting?

trigger_incident.what: 6 staged files of another agent swept into it

isolation: every scenario runs in a fresh mktemp repo; the live parent is never used as a test subject

verdict.adopted: git add <paths> && git commit -m msg -- <paths>, as ONE step
verdict.rejected_git_index_file: S7: an index seeded by an earlier read-tree HEAD SILENTLY REVERTS a concurrent commit (no conflict, no warning)
verdict.not_implemented_lock: needs a coordination primitive and universal cooperation; strictly more expensive than the pathspec rule and solves no extra case
verdict.mechanism: pre-commit guard in .githooks/pre-commit; detects bare vs pathspec via GIT_INDEX_FILE (bare=.git/index, pathspec=.git/next-index-<pid>.lock)

call_site_census.correction: the earlier '12 sites, 0 with pathspec' was WRONG TWICE: it counted error-message strings as call sites, and its grep missed the --only / -o plus separate-`--` argv form
call_site_census.union_rebase: NOT parent commits: both scripts take WT=${1:?hermit worktree path} and cd "$WT", so they use that worktree's own index

additional_measurement: bare `git commit --amend` sweeps identically to a bare commit; the bystander's staged file is absorbed and left unstaged
guard_modes_bracketed: warn: allows and NAMES the foreign staged path
follow_up: convert the parent-committing call sites (union-rebase amends, 2 sites in ci-hub/ci-hub.rs) to pathspec form, then flip the guard default to block

flip_verification.precondition: S13 proved `-o -- <path>` and `--only -- <paths>` are ALLOWED under block, commit only the named path, and leave a bystander's staged file untouched
flip_verification.live_negative: real hook + real index simulating a bare commit -> rc=1, BLOCKED, 113 staged paths reported (capped at 15)
flip_verification.live_positive: real hook simulating a pathspec commit -> guard SILENT (the rc=1 there was the pre-existing Reverie pin-drift guard, 0 occurrences of the guard's own marker)
flip_verification.escape_hatches: HERMIT_SHARED_INDEX_GUARD=warn -> rc=0; =off -> rc=0 and silent; HERMIT_PIN_DRIFT_OVERRIDE=1 unaffected
flip_verification.safety: a live BARE-commit test was deliberately NOT run: 113 other-agent paths were staged, so a guard failure would have swept real work. The hook was exercised directly instead, which is faithful and creates no commit.

usability_fix: the guard now caps its listing at 15 paths plus a count; with 113 staged it would otherwise print a wall of text, and a guard that floods the terminal gets disabled
